data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by the qwen model experiencing HTTP 400 API errors for 5 out of 7 files, resulting in an incomplete and inconclusive verdict, while the deepseek model successfully completed the audit and correctly identified the package as safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review 5 files (PKGBUILD, server.env, teamspeak-server.install, teamspeak-server.service, tsserver.yaml) due to LLM API HTTP 400 errors, leaving the audit incomplete.
learnings: Implement automatic retries or fallback models for LLM API calls to prevent transient HTTP errors from causing partial audits and inconclusive package verdicts.
